index.title: Convert — BudgetBakers Import
index.lead: Upload a bank Excel statement (.xlsx). USD/EUR amounts are converted to UAH using the NBU rate on the transaction date. All rows go to one account from the directory.
index.empty_accounts: The accounts directory is empty. First {link}add or load accounts{/link}.
index.account_hint: List from the {link}accounts directory{/link}. The same name for every row.
index.drop_hint: Drop a file here or click to choose
index.hint_status: Processes the bank statement and exports CSV or imports into BudgetBakers via API
index.hint_fx: Converts the transaction currency to UAH — via NBU
index.hint_mapping: Applies categories from the {link}mapping{/link}; if unmapped — keeps the category from the import file
index.hint_csv: Separates the counterparty and the transaction description {code}
preview.title: Preview — BudgetBakers Import
preview.lead: Uncheck rows you do not want in the CSV or BudgetBakers import.
preview.filter_hint: Filters only hide rows; checked state of hidden rows is kept for import/CSV.
preview.dedup_api_warn: Could not check duplicates via Wallet API — using local history only.
history.title: History — BudgetBakers Import
history.lead: Recent successful imports into BudgetBakers (up to 100 entries).
history.empty: No imports yet. After a successful import from the preview, entries will appear here.
accounts.title: Accounts — BudgetBakers Import
accounts.lead: BudgetBakers accounts for the {code} CSV column. Load via API or add a name manually. Stored in {file}.
accounts.no_token: API token is not set ({code}). You can still add account names manually below.
accounts.empty: Directory is empty. Refresh from API or add an account manually — otherwise conversion is unavailable.
categories.title: Categories — BudgetBakers Import
categories.lead: Bank categories from recent uploads are matched to BudgetBakers category names. Groups in the list are parent categories in Wallet (e.g. Food & Drinks → Groceries). The mapping stores only the leaf category name in {file} — as BudgetBakers CSV expects. If the directory is empty or a category has no match — the import file name is written to CSV as-is.
categories.no_token: API token is not set ({code}). You can type category names manually in the field below.
categories.empty: No bank categories yet. First {link}upload an Excel file{/link} — the list will appear here.
err.add_account_first: Add an account to the directory first (Accounts).
err.pick_account: Choose an account from the directory list.
err.job_not_found: Job not found or expired. {link}Upload the file again{/link}.
err.pick_rows_csv: Select at least one transaction to download CSV.
err.already_imported: This job has already been imported.
err.pick_rows_import: Select at least one transaction to import.
err.need_account_id: Account has no BudgetBakers ID. Refresh the directory from the API.
ok.accounts_refreshed: Updated from API: {n} accounts (manual entries kept).
err.file_too_large: The file is too large (max {max_mb} MiB).
parse.missing_columns: Required columns not found: {missing}. File headers: {headers}
fx.rate_missing: Row {source_row} ({op_date}): NBU rate for {currency} on {op_date} (and {lookback} days back) was not found
wallet.token_missing: BUDGETBAKERS_API_TOKEN is not set. Add a token in .env.
wallet.unauthorized: BudgetBakers API: invalid or expired token (401).
wallet.missing_item: No result for this row in the API response.
